Secretariat.title: Document tracking
Secretariat.introFull: Government policy: every document must be processed within 72 h. Click 🔔 Remind to notify the holder.
Secretariat.introScopedSingular: View scoped to your org-chart perimeter ({count} role in your subtree). Government policy: every document must be processed within 72 h.
Secretariat.introScopedPlural: View scoped to your org-chart perimeter ({count} roles in your subtree). Government policy: every document must be processed within 72 h.
Secretariat.secAtDgIntro: Awaiting analysis (newly arrived) or final decision (returned by a department after treatment).
Secretariat.secAtDgEmpty: No dossier with the GM at the moment.
Secretariat.secDispatchedIntro: Out of the GM, now with units. The duration is computed from when the current holder received it (internal delegation resets the counter).
Secretariat.secDispatchedEmpty: No dossier in flight across the units.
Secretariat.secReceivedIntro: Dossiers currently assigned to your role or to a role under your responsibility. The SLA counter starts at the time of assignment.
Secretariat.secReceivedEmpty: No active assignment in your subtree.
Secretariat.secSentIntro: Dossiers you (or a subordinate) handed off that are currently with another service. The SLA counter starts at the time of dispatch.
Secretariat.secSentEmpty: No sent dossier awaiting action elsewhere.
Secretariat.secExternalIntro: Transmissions sent to external recipients (Min. Finance, DGI, DGD, etc.) and still awaiting return. The SLA is computed from the date sent (or expected return date if set).
Secretariat.reminderTooltip: Send a reminder to the document's current holder

CourrierArrivee.title: Incoming Mail — Registration
CourrierArrivee.newDocumentIntro: Enter the sender's details, attach the scanned document and submit. The official reference is generated automatically and the acknowledgement is dispatched immediately.
CourrierArrivee.filePickerEmpty: No file selected · PDF or image (≤ 10 MB)
CourrierArrivee.filePickerHintActive: As soon as a file is chosen, the document is analysed and the fields below are pre-filled. You can correct anything.
CourrierArrivee.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. Approval request · 50 MW solar power plant project
CourrierArrivee.labelNotes: Internal note (optional · visible only to the GM and Incoming Mail)
CourrierArrivee.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Received in 2 signed original copies.
CourrierArrivee.submitFooter: ⓘ The sender will receive an email acknowledgement. The legal clock starts now.
CourrierArrivee.panelIdleHeading: Attach a file to run the automatic analysis
CourrierArrivee.panelIdleIntro: As soon as a PDF or image is selected, the document is analysed automatically and the fields on the left are pre-filled. The essentials are summarised here in under 50 words.
CourrierArrivee.panelAnalyzingHint: Usually 2–6 seconds for a single-page letter. You can start filling the fields on the left while it runs.
CourrierArrivee.panelErrorFooter: Fill the fields manually on the left — registration is still possible.
CourrierArrivee.panelDemoIntro: Automatic analysis is not active on this server. Fill in the fields on the left — registration is still possible.
CourrierArrivee.panelFieldsFooter: Fields highlighted in green on the left = pre-filled automatically. You can correct anything.

CourrierDepart.title: Outgoing Mail
CourrierDepart.intro: Compose and dispatch official responses after the GM's decision.
CourrierDepart.composeIntro: Draft the response to the sender. Once sent, the dossier moves to "Response sent" and the GM is notified.
